chunks: Whatever is in it from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Farrāʾ, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Farrāʾ.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates formal narration of a report.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفَرَّاءِ: From Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Farrāʾ; identifies the source figure in the chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Farrāʾ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Farrāʾ. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission route for hadith material in the book and preserving attribution within hadith scholarship.
